description: The file 'tasks_page.dart' is a Flutter widget implementing the TasksPage UI for a task management app. It manages task filtering, displays a list of tasks with detailed info, and handles navigation to task creation/editing screens. It references external repositories and models for tasks, projects, and tags.

classes.name: TasksPage
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays a list of tasks with filtering options and navigation to task creation/edit screens.

classes.name: _TasksPageState
classes.description: State class for TasksPage managing filters, stream of tasks, and UI updates.

classes.name: _TaskListTile
classes.description: A widget representing a single task item in the list, showing task details and actions.

classes.name: _StatusFilterChip
classes.description: Dropdown widget to filter tasks by status.

classes.name: _ProjectDropdown
classes.description: Dropdown widget to select a project filter, fed by project repository stream.

classes.name: _TagDropdown
classes.description: Dropdown widget to select a tag filter, fed by tag repository stream.

classes.name: _ProjectLabel
classes.description: Displays the project name associated with a project ID, streamed from project repository.

classes.name: _TagsWrap
classes.description: Displays chips for tags associated with a task, streamed from tag repository.

methods.name: _buildFilters
methods.description: Builds the filter UI components for task status, project, and tags.

methods.name: _buildStreamList
methods.description: Builds the list of tasks based on stream data, applying filters.

methods.name: _matchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a task matches the current filter criteria.

methods.name: _toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task and updates the repository.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the TaskFormPage for creating a new task.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the TaskFormPage for editing a selected task.
